handoffs.message: Please review task/L12-REC-001 at 46ee200fa. Evidence: docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-REC-001 (checksum verified). Validation: reconciliation suite 94 passed; affected foundation/Postgres/lifecycle suite 26 passed; py_compile and Ruff F/E9 passed. Focus review on CAS lease recovery, equal external IDs across tenants, token-bound tenant filtering, SLA/timeout behavior, corrupt-state preservation, and no duplicate incident side effects.

Review rejected at 46ee200fa / PR #4150. Required fixes: (1) bind ConsumerWorkerState checkpoint save/release to the acquired lease_token with CAS and renewal or fail-closed ownership checks; regression must prove that after lease expiry a successor acquires and the stale worker cannot overwrite the successor token/checkpoints (current reproduction: successor_lease_preserved=False). (2) tenant-scope consumer pending/dead_letters/completed identity by tenant+event, or strictly constrain the worker to one configured tenant; equal external event IDs for tenant-a and tenant-b must both enqueue/deliver (current second enqueue=False). (3) tenant-aware JSON and Postgres get_* legacy/raw-key fallback must verify exact tenant before returning; current tenant-b get_drift_report returns a tenant-a record. Existing 94 reconciliation tests and 26 affected tests pass, as do py_compile, evidence checksum and PR required checks, so add regression coverage for these acceptance failures before re-handoff.

PR #4150 updated at ba5090aa558455aabd2afe39a30cf22be077b32e. Fixed all rejected acceptance gaps: token-CAS/renewed consumer checkpoints and token-bound release preserve successor state after expiry (including same worker_id); pending/DLQ/completed use tenant+event identity so equal IDs for two tenants both deliver; all JSON/Postgres get_* raw fallbacks require exact tenant. Evidence checksum verified. Validation at merged dev: reconciliation 98 passed; affected 26 passed; py_compile and Ruff F/E9 passed.

Independent review approved PR #4150 head ba5090aa558455aabd2afe39a30cf22be077b32e: stale consumer save/release is fenced by acquired lease-token CAS and successor checkpoint preservation; consumer delivery identity is tenant+event; JSON/Postgres legacy fallback enforces exact tenant.
